title: Use Motion Previs Studio v4 to extract pose, depth, camera moves, and control…
content: Use Motion Previs Studio v4 to extract pose, depth, camera moves, and control layers from reference shots, then feed those controls into Seedance for more consistent AI video generation.
tips: Use Motion Previs Studio v4 to extract pose, depth, camera moves, and control layers from reference shots, then feed those controls into Seedance for more consistent AI video generation.

es.content: Utiliza Motion Previs Studio v4 para extraer poses, profundidad, movimientos de cámara y capas de control de tomas de referencia, luego introduce esos controles en Seedance para una generación de video AI más consistente.

fr.content: Utilisez Motion Previs Studio v4 pour extraire les poses, la profondeur, les mouvements de caméra et les couches de contrôle à partir de prises de référence, puis intégrez ces contrôles dans Seedance pour une génération de vidéos IA plus cohérente.

ja.content: Motion Previs Studio v4を使用して、参照ショットからポーズ、深度、カメラの動き、コントロールレイヤーを抽出し、それらのコントロールをSeedanceに入力して、より一貫したAIビデオ生成を行います。

ko.content: Motion Previs Studio v4를 사용하여 참조 샷에서 포즈, 깊이, 카메라 움직임 및 제어 레이어를 추출한 다음, 이러한 제어를 Seedance에 입력하여 보다 일관된 AI 비디오 생성을 수행하세요.

pt.content: Use o Motion Previs Studio v4 para extrair pose, profundidade, movimentos de câmera e camadas de controle de tomadas de referência, depois insira esses controles no Seedance para uma geração de vídeo por IA mais consistente.

zh.content: 使用 Motion Previs Studio v4 从参考镜头中提取姿势、深度、镜头移动和控制层，然后将这些控制输入 Seedance，以实现更一致的 AI 视频生成。
